name: TAFE NSW Equity Scholarship
summary: $1,000 scholarships for TAFE NSW students facing hardship, such as First Nations students, people with disability or Centrelink recipients.
who: Identify with an equity group: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, disability or chronic illness, unemployed 6+ months, Centrelink recipient, at-risk youth, or domestic and family violence.
Australian citizen, permanent resident, humanitarian visa holder or NZ citizen living in NSW.
Studying or planning to study an accredited VET course at TAFE NSW.
how: Apply with a statement of circumstances, evidence of hardship and a signed referee statement.
catches: Applications are currently closed; the page lists eight scholarships per semester, so check for the next round.
